title: Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - Evaluating Responses - Ties
subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: Following a rigorous RFP evaluation, the evaluation committee calculates the final scores. Vendor A and Vendor B have exactly the same total score out of 1000 points. What is the appropriate mechanism to resolve this tie?
options: Ask the requesting department director to choose their favorite
Apply the agency's formal tie-breaking procedure (e.g., local preference, coin toss) as defined by statute or policy
Award the contract to the vendor who submitted their proposal first
questions.explain: Ties must be broken systematically using objective, predetermined methods established by agency policy or state statute, such as granting preference to an in-state vendor, a certified minority vendor, or drawing lots.
